scripts.deploy:dev: pnpm run build:dev && wrangler deploy --env dev
scripts.docker:reset: export STAMP=$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S) && mkdir -p api/data/exports && docker compose exec -T api node dist/cli/main ledger:export > api/data/exports/$STAMP.json && test -s api/data/exports/$STAMP.json && docker compose down && rm -f api/data/ubc.sqlite* && docker compose up -d --build --wait && docker compose exec -T api node dist/cli/main fund:seed && docker compose exec -T api node dist/cli/main ledger:demo
scripts.db: docker compose exec -T api node dist/cli/main db:stats
scripts.data:pull: ssh ubc-prod 'cd ubc && set -a && . deploy/prod.env && set +a && docker compose exec -T api node dist/cli/main ledger:export' | docker compose run --rm -T api node dist/cli/main ledger:import
scripts.private:export: docker compose exec -T api node dist/cli/main ledger:export
scripts.views: docker compose exec -T api node dist/cli/main report:views
scripts.server:dev: docker compose --env-file deploy/dev.env -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.server.yml up -d --build --wait
scripts.server:dev:logs: docker compose --env-file deploy/dev.env -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.server.yml logs -f
scripts.server:prod:logs: docker compose --env-file deploy/prod.env -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.server.yml logs -f
scripts.private:demo: docker compose exec -T api node dist/cli/main ledger:demo
